description: Edit/regenerate done right: animated staggered prune of everything below, single response only (one-turn guard + no duplicate user persist), and the edited message resends with the last-20 context.
features: Prune-below animates out (staggered fade/slide) before removal.
One-turn guard stops double responses; edit resend reuses the user id (no duplicate).
Edit resend uses last-20 context (the edited message + 20 before it).
